vetSays.line: 🛡️ Saul, Hank, Maeve and Adarsh met them at the door — 4 put down. Saul, Hank, Maeve, Adarsh are hurt.
🛡️ Hank, Maeve and Adarsh met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Maeve, Adarsh are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Hank, Maeve, Adarsh and Benjamin met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Hank, Maeve, Adarsh, Benjamin are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Naran just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Naran just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Omar just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Giulia just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Naran, Elena, Omar and Giulia met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Naran, Elena, Omar, Giulia are hurt.
🛡️ Ella, Amina and Tariq met them at the door — 3 put down. Ella, Amina, Tariq are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aria just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Elder Dustboar is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
You STRIKE the Elder Dustboar for 115 (Starfall lance).
Elder Dustboar's attack hits you for 1.
You STRIKE the Elder Dustboar for 120 (Starfall lance).
The Elder Dustboar falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Dustboar!
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mara just put down The Influencer... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mara just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ernestine just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ernestine and Mário met them at the door — 2 put down. Ernestine, Mário are hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Ernestine taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.

Sofia has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Fireside lesson: Ernestine passes around Ground Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mário just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
Mário: "Walked past a good stand of ground elder. Worth remembering where."
